question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A book or set of books giving information about all areas of knowledge
solution:
The correct answer is "**Encyclopedia**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• **Encyclopedia is a noun that refers to a book or set of books that provides information on all areas of knowledge**.

 
 
• Examples of famous encyclopedias include Britannica, World Book, and Wikipedia.
 
 
 
• Dictionary refers to a book that provides definitions of words and their meanings.
 
 
• ​Example: They gifted me a dictionary.
 
 
 
• Volume refers to a book that is part of a series or set, or a measure of the amount of space something occupies.
 
 
• ​Example: I have read all the volumes of Harry potter.
 
 
 
• Anthology refers to a collection of literary works, such as poems or short stories.
 
 
• ​Example: They have just published an anthology of motivational poems.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​**From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "encyclopedia" can substitute the given phrase.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
